responsibility: This machine description supplies the DFA scheduling model for the 24K family cores, covering 24kc and the 24kf variants with different FPU clock ratios. It defines execution resources, reservation patterns, and many bypass rules for integer, multiply/divide, load/store, branch, and floating-point instructions, distinguishing the half-clocked and 1:1-clocked FP configurations so GCC’s MIPS scheduler can model both the base 24K integer core and its FPU-dependent tuning variants accurately.
